ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio estimated at 6:1; central high-intensity white/light-gray region (approx. 80% surface area) bounded by low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant, contiguous high-intensity white zone covers the inner lobes and peduncle connection. A low-intensity black band (0,0,0 range) forms a continuous perimeter along the trailing edge, widening significantly at the primary and secondary tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 85-degree acute V-shaped notch; vertical depth is approximately 1/7th of the fluke's total visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of variations increases distally, with significant jagged protrusions and notches on the far right and left lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-contrast circular depressions and subtle grey-scale circular clusters distributed across the mid-ventral white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct, high-contrast dark/reddish linear mark (approx. 150 pixels in length) located on the upper right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible reddish linear scar on the right lobe; extensive irregular jagged edges on the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Surface exhibits a widespread 'dimpled' topography across the high-intensity regions, visible via subtle shadow casting.
